⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Highly Recommended!

We recently left our poodle Vader at this animal clinic while we were away, and I couldn’t be happier with the care he received. You can truly see how well they looked after him — he came home happy, relaxed, and clearly comfortable from his stay.

The staff treated him like their own. They gave regular updates, made sure he was safe, well-fed, and cared for, and they even paid attention to his little quirks and habits. It’s such a relief knowing that Vader was in a warm, friendly environment instead of feeling stressed or lonely.

Thank you to everyone at the clinic for taking such good care of our boy. We will definitely trust you again the next time we travel. Highly recommended for pet owners who want peace of mind while they’re away! 🐾❤️

— Vader’s Owner
Had our beautiful girls teeth cleaned here. The staff were so friendly and helpful and the price is really reasonable. Recommend if you need a vet in Chiang Mai

Avoid — records withheld until Embassy intervened; legal threats after.

I’m posting this to warn other pet owners.

Care seemed fine at first. Then a payment misunderstanding arose.

When I requested my cat’s medical records, the clinic blocked me on LINE and stopped replying.

The records were released only after our Embassy phoned the clinic.

After that Embassy intervention, the clinic contacted me on Facebook saying they would pursue legal action and involve police/immigration.

We were also advised to pay for a service that, after checking the requirements, was not needed for our pet’s travel.

These are, in my view, non-negotiable red flags:
withholding records until outside authorities step in, blocking the client during a dispute, and post-hoc threats of legal escalation.

I strongly do not recommend this clinic. If there’s any disagreement, you may lose communication access, wait on vital records until someone else intervenes, and then face threats. There are better, more professional options.

They take great care of our chow chows. We can choose between the convenience of an in home visit or they will send a car to collect and return the kids. They also offer grooming services. Dr. Nook is our go to for doggie care in Chiang Mai.

Can't praise Dr.Nook highly enough.
My dog was attacked by 2 other and they broke her leg.  Dr. NOOK called in an orthopedic specialist from the University.  They performed nearly microsurgery attaching a metal plate to the 2 ends to stabilize the leg.  She is on the way to full recovery.  Without this she would have limped and been in pain for much of her future.

We’ve been bringing Kasha to Dr Nook Animal Hospital for her arthritis care for the past year and a half, and we couldn’t be happier with the care she’s received. The vet has been incredibly professional, compassionate, and attentive to Kasha’s needs, ensuring she’s as comfortable as possible.
We also trust them to look after our other two cats as it is clear they genuinely care about their well-being. We trust that our cats are in capable and caring hands, and appreciate the wonderful care they continue to provide.

I simply can't say enough good things about Dr. Nook and her staff.  She has been my go to vet since we first moved to Chiang Mai eight years ago.  From routine appointments for vaccinations, to annual teeth cleaning and even delicate surgery on my dog's eyelid to remove a growth, our three dogs are treated gently, and with compassion and kindness.  I can always count of a quick response when I text the clinic with a question or concern and on more than one occasion, this has spared me a trip to the clinic.

Took my dog here for a check up and to care for him when he was sick. The doctors and staff here are amazing! Very understanding about offering options, very thorough explanation for condition and treatment options. Highly recommended!!! They truly are fantastic, awesome group here, don't waste your time trying somewhere else!
They are lovely vets!! This place was the light in the end of a tunnel for me, i found here very professional and caring people who actually love pets for real. Best service with best vets !

Dr Nook and her staff operate a professional, caring and wonderful veterinary clinic.  We have been there several times and are very happy with the service.  We are grateful there is such a great clinic in Chiang Mai for our dog Bodhi's needs.  We highly recommend Dr Nook!

I have no words to explain how much I love Dr Nook and her team. They have saved the life of my cat after a wrong diagnosis by another vet, and made me feel at ease from the moment I reached out to them.

Staff are caring, polite, great English and highly competent. I knew exactly what I was paying and was informed about the step by step treatment plans throughout. The team were one of the best surgery’s I have every visited in Thailand for their care and attention, and I’ve lived in the country over 20 years now. If you are in Chiang Mai, there is really no better practice (even the ones that claim to be). If you have a sick pet, both short term or long term issues, this is the place to come.

A friend recommended this animal hospital. It was the best advice we got! Our adopted cat has got excellent, caring treatment by Dr Mattanee at Dr Nook Animal Hospital. She is just so passionate, and the other staff are no less passionate about their work. And perhaps no less importantly, the clinic charges reasonably too. Kudos to everyone there!!!

Veterinary staff is knowledgeable and explain the medical treatment clearly(make sure you give all symptoms and ask relevant questions) in English. They don't try to upsell you on unnecessary treatments and sell Science Diet wet food, treats, small collars, Bravecto, med/small soft cones, animal's dental health products and more. If your furry friend requires medication they will try to help give the first dose at their office. They also wash and cut animal fur. I've had my dog washed there before and they did such a good job brushing him I genuinely thought they gave him a trim at first.

**They do provide euthanasia services as well.**

Dr. Nook is the best vet in town!  And those “in the know” know it!

Whether your pet needs routine vaccinations or requires a life-saving surgery, she’s the one you want.

EXCELLENT COMMUNICATION skills in Thai and English, combined with STELLAR CLINICAL EXPERTISE are what sets her apart from the rest.

She is also compassionate in matters involving end-of-life treatment.

Look no further!

I arrived in CM four years ago with my 9 yoa Tonkinese. I've been to many clinics across the US, and one other in CM during the past 19 years as a cat owner. I brought a neighborhood soi cat into another CM clinic closer to my home a few months ago for treatment of wounds received from fighting, and a general exam. The very large size clinic treatment was satisfactory, with an English-speaking vet that I knew nothing about i.e., years of experience, education, etc. He did an adequate job, but the experience was somewhat impersonal and detached, making me feel as if we were on a conveyor belt along with the many other pets, doctors and staff that were running around this clinic.

Several weeks ago Chai was afflicted with vestibular disease which devastated me, and was also difficult for Chai, needless to say. After a lengthy internet search for a clinic I could feel comfortable with we arrived at Dr. Nook's. Treatment for this disease requires office visits one/two times a week for several months, so we have been working with Dr. Nook for a couple months now. I could go on at length about Dr. Nook and staff, but instead tell you that I am thoroughly satisficed and comfortable with her and the clinic, and would highly recommend Dr. Nook if in the need of veterinary care while in CM.
The best animal hospital in Chiang Mai.  The care given is second to none, Doctors and staff are outstanding, I would never take my dogs anywhere else.  I trust the doctor and her team completely

I am very grateful to these doctors for their wonderful care of my pet dog. Always helpful and concerned and explain his health and answer all my questions. Plus they are kind and gentle to my dog. I highly recommend them!

Very nice and professional doctors. They always provide good explanations in Thai as well as in English on everything, including the process how to take a thai animal to our country. I was disappointed from CMU small animals hospitals where I couldn't get answers very easily. I'm very glad I found this clinic!
Wonderful vet. Extremely kind (to both people and pet!), and knowledgeable. They are well equipped and speak very good English as well.
My dog loves Dr. Nook and other doctors and everyone in the hospital! Kind and friendly animal hospital. Highly recommended ❤️⭐️ 🐩 …
One of the best animal hospitals in Chiang Mai, always come only here!
Nice English Speaking Doctor. Professional care and fair price. She can give good advice to Beginner Pet owners.

I am a new cat owner and a farang with nit noy Thai, but these people were just great. Excellent English, precise instructions and advice, and a great location east of Old City near Better than Butter and close to Pantip Plaza
Best vet in Chiang Mai. Fixed my dog’s 2 year on and off chronic ear infection in a week.
Dr. Nook has all the information on how to travel with your pet internationally. She has each country's requirements listed out and has experience with the process.
I am very happy with Dr Nook and her vet staff. They are always professional, explain everything and speak English well

Fantastic staff, quick and thorough.

If you take your pet (my cat, in my case) to Chiang Mai and something goes wrong with it, go here!

They are kind and explain exactly what to do in great detail!

I failed the rabies antibody test I had done in Korea, so I had the test done here here, just like in Bangkok, Thailand. (Of course, I received the rabies shot at this clinic a month before the test.)

I had my blood drawn a month after the rabies shot, and 25 days later, I received the rabies antibody test results for entry into Korea.

When departing, you come to this clinic to get a health certificate (700 baht), then go to the Chiang Mai Quarantine Office and hand over your prepared documents to receive an exit permit (250 baht).

See the photo below for the documents you need to prepare.

When I rescued a stray cat, I had it examined for a health check. I had it examined, had its nails clipped, and bought food for the time being, but the total cost was about 2,000 baht. If there were discounts for rescued cats, rescuers would be much happier.

The veterinarians at this clinic lack the qualifications and ethics to run a clinic, and we have already reported this clinic to the Thai Veterinary Council and other relevant agencies.

These vets clearly lack the qualifications and ethics to run a clinic. We’ve already reported them to the Thai Veterinary Council.

We were promised to receive the test results within 7 days after payment. However, the clinic extended this period without any prior notice, then blocked us on LINE, prompting us to reach out via Facebook Messenger.

We politely asked them to send the test results and voluntarily clarify the unjust fee they had charged. Despite this, the clinic failed to provide the results for over two weeks.

After we contacted the embassy for support, the clinic responded by sending a message threatening to report us to the police and the tourism authority. (But nothing happened to us LOL)

As a result, we have reported this clinic to both the Tourist Police and the Thai Veterinary Council.

(The Korean person mentioned below) There are 700 kilos of books and 100 kilos of books. I'm the one who's got a lot of money and I'm the one who's got a lot of money. It's the same as the last one. It's time to leave the house.

This was my first time at this pet hospital; my puppy was a little over a month old. The vet checked him over and said he was fine! Then he applied flea and tick medication to his skin, which cost a little over 600 baht. He told us to get his vaccinations in a week! It should have been a happy occasion. A week later, we went to another vet, who found he had been bitten by insects and needed to be treated again. They also gave him oral flea and tick medication (because they were worried about intestinal worms), and told him the vaccinations couldn't be given until he was two months old! That's when I realized this pet hospital wasn't very good!
The doctor was kind, and the staff took excellent care of my child. There was no double standard.

The vet is kind and very good at taking care of our cat. I had a health checkup, and the vet explained everything clearly. Taking our cat abroad was easy and convenient; all the paperwork was complete. They also offer microchipping at a standard price.
